text:
ITEM 1 | Breaded piece with golden-brown to dark reddish-brown crumb coating, rough craggy surface with small dark specks, irregular chunky shape about 9 cm long and 5 cm wide, partially eaten with a torn edge and exposed pale interior at the top-left; sits on the plate's left-center | 110

ITEM 2 | Second breaded piece, same brown crunchy coating, roughly triangular wedge about 10 cm across, with a cut edge showing pale interior; lies on the lower-center of the plate and is topped by slaw | 120

ITEM 3 | Shredded pale cream-white coleslaw-style mix with thin strands, slightly glossy and moist-looking, mounded about 6 cm by 4 cm over the breaded piece, with flecks of orange carrot shreds and small bright green herb leaves scattered through it | 35

ITEM 4 | Thin orange carrot shreds, bright orange, matchstick-like, scattered across the slaw and plate, a few pieces about 3 to 4 cm long | 5

ITEM 5 | Small bright green herb leaves, flat and fresh-looking, a handful of single leaves about 1 to 2 cm each, scattered on the slaw | 2

ITEM 6 | Small crumbs of brown breading, dark brown, dry and crumbly, a few tiny pieces scattered on the plate near the top of the breaded piece and right edge | 3
